title: Use a returned value
prompt: Write `square`, which returns its parameter times itself. In `square_plus_one`, store square(n) in a variable, add the number `1` to it, and return the result. square_plus_one(3) is 10.
hints: What a function returns can be caught in a variable.

docs.name: return value
docs.what: Ends the function and hands value back to whoever called it.
